setup: Two organisations with distinct users and sources
action: Read/update/download another tenant object by guessed ID; repeat for findings, assets, comments, exports and insights
expected: 404 without content leakage; no mutation or new audit data in victim tenant

setup: Creator, manager, admin and separately assigned reviewer
action: Attempt approval as each identity, including creator with reviewer role
expected: Only assigned non-author reviewer succeeds; server denies all other attempts

setup: Approved revision r1; browser retains old version token
action: Create r2 then approve/export r1 as current; race edit against approval
expected: 409 for stale operations; no approval inherited by r2; transactional outcome is consistent

setup: Approved run with source epoch 1
action: Activate changed source concurrently with decision/export; expire a source
expected: Fresh export requires current effective source snapshot; historical decision remains visible as stale

setup: Terminology and trial facts from two synthetic brands
action: Review correct and incorrect spelling, trial durations and word-boundary near matches
expected: Only valid violations flagged at exact locations with correct rule/source; no LumaDesk hardcoding

setup: Claim policy plus absent, expired and conflicting evidence
action: Review a numeric promotion under each evidence condition
expected: Unsupported/unverified/conflicting distinguished from false; conflict routed to source owner

setup: Tone/messaging rules and context; valid model adapter
action: Review calm text, pressure language, different audiences and stylistic variants
expected: Advisory contextual findings cite real rules; no unsupported replacement facts or dialect-as-error assumption

setup: Adapter stub capable of returning malformed responses
action: Return invented source IDs, wrong quotes, out-of-range offsets, bad JSON and extra instructions
expected: Reject invalid findings; mark semantic check failed; preserve deterministic findings and block clean status

setup: Supported and hostile real document fixtures
action: Extract PDF/DOCX including scanned/encrypted PDF, zip bomb, oversized file and empty text
expected: Correct canonical locations; unsupported inputs rejected; bounded time/memory; no empty clean review

setup: PNG/JPEG plus asset hashes, dimensions and colour-pair metadata
action: Check original vs altered asset, missing alt text, 4.49/4.5 and 2.99/3.0 contrast boundaries, unknown font size
expected: Exact identity only; no embedded-logo certification; appropriate thresholds; uncertainty/manual review shown

setup: LumaDesk fixture and live services
action: Curate, paste draft, analyse, open evidence, edit, reanalyse, submit, review as separate user, export
expected: Journey succeeds without mocks; evidence and exported hash match the exact revision and decision

setup: Open finding and submitted revision
action: Edit suggestion before applying, comment, compare revisions, request changes then resubmit
expected: Original preserved; each saved edit creates revision; comments show actor/time and correct revision

setup: Unresolved claim blocker and failed required check
action: Request exception; try creator grant, reviewer grant without reason, then valid authorised grant
expected: Only reasoned authorised revision-specific finding exception succeeds; failed check still blocks until rerun/manual completion

setup: Queued jobs; worker and database available
action: Kill worker after lease; restart; retry same request; deliver late old-run result
expected: Lease reclaimed; single authoritative result; old run cannot overwrite new; retry exhaustion visible

setup: Model unavailable, extraction timeout and database interruption
action: Submit analysis under each fault and recover
expected: Explicit incomplete/failed state; no clean/approved result; retriable work safely resumes

setup: Review desk at desktop and narrow viewport
action: Keyboard-only journey, drawer focus/escape, error focus, 200% zoom, screen-reader status checks
expected: No trapped/lost focus, hidden controls or colour-only status; labels and announcements understandable

setup: Repeated confirmed/dismissed findings and ambiguity reports across revisions
action: Open insights; repeat analysis of same content without new confirmation
expected: Counts use explicit reviewed-item denominator and dedup policy; dismissals separate; no cross-tenant counts

setup: Live release with files and approved content
action: Restart stack; restore backup into separate environment; roll back previous compatible image
expected: Data/file hashes survive; one restored export works; rollback procedure measured and recorded

setup: External browser with no team session
action: Open HTTPS demo, inspect readiness/build SHA, perform workflow and request private file directly
expected: Valid certificate; demo usable without assistance; deployed SHA matches; unauthenticated private files denied

setup: Local mode and unapproved external provider; outbound request spy
action: Analyse content; enable provider only through admin policy then repeat
expected: Zero external analysis before opt-in; disclosure precedes processing; model/prompt/provider versions captured

setup: Content with original, extraction, cache, findings and backup
action: Request deletion; run retention job; restore backup and reapply deletion records
expected: All active content derivatives gone; expired links fail; minimal audit retained as documented; backup expiry recorded

setup: Malicious HTML, prompt instructions and cross-site requests
action: Render upload/finding/comment; attempt CSRF, session misuse and model tool instructions
expected: No script execution, unauthorised mutation, publishing/tool call or cross-tenant source retrieval; secrets absent from logs

setup: Frozen labelled evaluation items with template split
action: Run evaluation and human citation support review; record disagreements and per-category metrics
expected: No split leakage or invented labels; denominators and misses reported; citations resolvable; targets compared honestly

setup: Consenting non-builder testers where available
action: Observe unassisted core tasks and record help/errors; revise one observed issue
expected: Real anonymised observations, sample and limitations saved; internal sessions labelled if users unavailable

setup: Deployed build with documented hardware/provider
action: Run 30 supported reviews including five concurrent submissions
expected: Record p50/p95, incomplete rate and queue delay; no dropped jobs; timeout terminal by configured limit

setup: Shared OpenAPI and canonical fixtures
action: Generate client, compile web, validate API examples and error enums
expected: No contract drift; UI handles each status; production has no mock transport

setup: Final submission bundle and repository
action: Open links in fresh browser; inspect PDF, feature list, deltas, three improvements, contributions and disclosures
expected: All stage items present, accurate, readable and tied to real work; individual required fields completed

setup: Draft extracted guideline with owner and validity dates
action: Try activating as creator and activating conflicting facts; manager verifies and resolves conflict
expected: Only manager activates verified versions; conflicts explicitly resolved; old versions immutable

setup: Release dependency manifests, images and repository
action: Run secret/dependency scans and inspect licences, credentials, storage/network settings
expected: No committed secrets or unresolved exploitable critical/high issues; disclosure ledger and operational findings recorded

setup: Text with emoji/combining characters plus PDF/DOCX/image content
action: Open findings and apply selected edit across formats; test unsupported file UI
expected: Locations match canonical code points; document/image context visible; safe editable suggestions; errors preserve draft
